## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive, with Communication, Energy, Utilities and Real Estate up 1W while Tech, Financials and Industrials head the lag; confirmation 1) mixed sector returns (4/11 positive) and 2) large-cap Tech mostly BELOW TREND while top performers are spread across sectors. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5); Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Communication leads: CMCSA (1W: +1.74% | 1M: +12.45%) ABOVE TREND, CHTR (1W: +1.69% | 1M: +6.00%) ABOVE TREND, TMUS (1W: +2.72% | 1M: -1.74%) RECOVERY — Tech: 6/19 positive. Energy showing selective strength: XOM (1W: +0.77% | 1M: +3.18%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +2.54% | 1M: -2.32%) RECOVERY — Energy: 5/8 positive. Utilities marginally up (sector 1W +0.52%) with pocketed support; monitor for defensives.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Financials lag 1W with multiple trend-exhaustion names: C (1W: -2.27% | 1M: +13.64%) CORRECTION, GS (1W: -2.52% | 1M: +8.94%) CORRECTION, JPM (1W: -1.14% | 1M: +4.31%) CORRECTION — Financials: 6/20 positive. Industrials weak: GE (1W: -2.27% | 1M: +6.91%) CORRECTION, CAT (1W: -1.64% | 1M: +0.85%) CORRECTION. Technology under pressure: AAPL (1W: -0.18% | 1M: -3.97%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -0.66% | 1M: -0.64%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -1.43% | 1M: +3.66%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: NKE (1W: +11.11% | 1M: -2.57%) RECOVERY, TGT (1W: +3.66% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND, TMUS (1W: +2.72% | 1M: -1.74%) RECOVERY, OXY (1W: +2.54% | 1M: -2.32%) RECOVERY, KHC (1W: +2.32% | 1M: -4.41%) RECOVERY — Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: C (1W: -2.27% | 1M: +13.64%) CORRECTION, GE (1W: -2.27% | 1M: +6.91%) CORRECTION, MET (1W: -2.43% | 1M: +3.45%) CORRECTION, IBM (1W: -2.49% | 1M: -3.09%) BELOW TREND, GS (1W: -2.52% | 1M: +8.94%) CORRECTION — Weakness concentrated in Financials (3/5 Financials).

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W moves: NKE (1W: +11.11% | 1M: -2.57%) RECOVERY, TGT (1W: +3.66% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND, TMUS (1W: +2.72% | 1M: -1.74%) RECOVERY — market shows MAJOR divergence (many large names with 1W ≠ 1M), so treat momentum as tactical not conclusive.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed-to-weak with large-cap slippage; AAPL (1W: -0.18% | 1M: -3.97%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -0.66% | 1M: -0.64%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -1.43% | 1M: +3.66%) CORRECTION — Tech: 6/19 positive, internal rotation and leadership thinning.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Cyclical but fatigued; JPM (1W: -1.14% | 1M: +4.31%) CORRECTION, C (1W: -2.27% | 1M: +13.64%) CORRECTION, GS (1W: -2.52% | 1M: +8.94%) CORRECTION — Financials: 6/20 positive and showing trend-exhaustion signals.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Defensive anchors holding; JNJ (1W: +0.57% | 1M: +0.78%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +1.63% | 1M: +2.82%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +0.28% | 1M: +1.59%) ABOVE TREND — Healthcare: 7/15 positive with selective strength in large caps.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor selective exposure to Communication and Energy leaders (CMCSA, XOM) and favor defensive Healthcare names (JNJ, UNH); reduce exposure to large-cap Tech and Financials showing trend-exhaustion (AAPL, MSFT, C, GS). Style: mixed / no clear leadership — be selective given major divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: CMCSA (1W: +1.74% | 1M: +12.45%) ABOVE TREND, TMUS (1W: +2.72% | 1M: -1.74%) RECOVERY, CVS (1W: +1.69% | 1M: +0.33%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: AAPL (1W: -0.18% | 1M: -3.97%) BELOW TREND, TSLA (1W: -7.38% | 1M: +4.55%) CORRECTION, C (1W: -2.27% | 1M: +13.64%) CORRECTION.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Communication (1W +1.50%) and Energy (1W +0.71%) given recent leadership and upgrades. BEARISH: Technology (1W -0.85%) and Financials (1W -1.61%) for signs of further trend-exhaustion.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA 450 resistance (NVDA (1W: -1.43% | 1M: +3.66%) CORRECTION) — break above would signal renewed leadership; AAPL 150 support (AAPL (1W: -0.18% | 1M: -3.97%) BELOW TREND) — failure below adds downside risk; JPM 160/170 area for trend confirmation (JPM (1W: -1.14% | 1M: +4.31%) CORRECTION); CMCSA 40–45 support to watch for ABOVE TREND continuation (CMCSA (1W: +1.74% | 1M: +12.45%) ABOVE TREND).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
TMUS (+50): T-Mobile upgrade on subscriber outlook; TMUS (1W: +2.72% | 1M: -1.74%) RECOVERY — sentiment confirming short-term price strength. CVS (+50): higher target from Bernstein; CVS (1W: +1.69% | 1M: +0.33%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. CAT (+50): target raised on 2026 recovery view; CAT (1W: -1.64% | 1M: +0.85%) CORRECTION — bullish headlines but 1W weakness = divergence to monitor.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
AAPL (-45): cuts to Vision Pro production; AAPL (1W: -0.18% | 1M: -3.97%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed by price. C (-45): Russia exit risk headlines; C (1W: -2.27% | 1M: +13.64%) CORRECTION — negative news aligning with 1W weakness despite 1M strength. INTU / INTC headlines show mixed signals across days; monitor for confirmation before acting.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with style mixed / no clear leadership; Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive and Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5). Communication and Energy names showing relative strength (CMCSA ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.74% | 1M: +12.45%), XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.77% | 1M: +3.18%)). Key risk is major divergence—multiple large caps with 1W ≠ 1M (AAPL, C, GS, TSLA), so monitor for trend breaks and sentiment-confirmation.
